source.title: Spatial mapping of RNA turnover kinetics in the mouse brain
source.anchor_matching: Whitespace-normalized exact matching only; custody remains the original source-byte SHA256. Register full source bytes with build_packet, then retain all paragraphs needed to support and distinguish both judgments.

bad.field_value: Under the steady-state kinetic model, use the new-to-total fraction and pulse duration to estimate gene-specific half-life and derive synthesis/degradation rates. Aggregate by anatomical region, or use RNAkinetoScope's transcriptome-similarity neighbors within the same spatial cluster for spot-level inference. Map estimates back to the originating registered spots.

good.field_value: Under the steady-state model, aggregate and normalize corrected counts by anatomical region, or use RNAkinetoScope's transcriptome-similarity neighbors within the same spatial cluster for spot-level inference. Retain normalized new-RNA abundance n separately from R = new/total. Estimate gene-specific half-life from R and pulse duration tL; calculate degradation γ from half-life. Estimate synthesis α using normalized labeled-RNA abundance n together with γ and tL, as α = nγ/(1 − exp(−γtL)). In the illustrated spot-level analysis, n is in CP10k and α in CP10k per minute; γ is in inverse minutes. RNAkinetoScope also imputes missing half-lives within clusters before rate estimation. Map inferred parameters back to the originating registered spots.
